sanskrit_verse:
श्रुत्वैतद् याज्ञवल्क्योऽपि प्रीतात्मा मुनिभाषितम् ।
एवमस्त्विति होवाच नमस्कृत्य स्वयंभुवे ॥
transliteration: śrutvaitad yājñavalyo'pi prītātmā munibhāṣitam | evam astv iti hovāca namaskṛtya svayaṃbhuve ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Having heard this declaration of the sage, Yajnavalkya himself, with a pleased soul, affirmed it thus—so be it—and bowed to the Self-existent.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with Self-existent Truth
Causation arises through conscious assent to Dharma
Capacity-based responsibility requires internal validation before external enactment
Restoration occurs through reverent acknowledgment of source-consciousness
Consciousness alignment is enacted through devotional submission to Svayambhu
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor hears Dharma-declaration AND affirms with inner joy THEN action is valid AND binding in svadharma
IF entity acknowledges Svayambhu BEFORE acting THEN act carries no karmic residue NOR punitive consequence
IF judicial process includes voluntary namaskara to svayambhava THEN outcome aligns with cosmic order
IF law is received with prītātmā THEN execution proceeds without resistance OR distortion
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, when a ruling is pronounced in alignment with Svayambhu and received with inner affirmation by all parties, the judgment becomes self-enforcing. No coercive mechanism required. The court's role is to ensure that each participant has acknowledged the Source prior to conclusion.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa here is śabda-pramāṇa validated through inner experience (prītātmā). Causality flows from svayaṃbhū to cognition to consent to utterance. There is no punitive element; correctness is established through alignment alone. Responsibility lies in recognition, not imposition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Participant must audibly affirm 'evam astu' upon hearing the truth
Reverence Protocol: Perform full namaskara to Svayambhu prior to executing decision
Inner Witness Activation: Confirm alignment through spontaneous rise of prīti
Integrity Reintegration: No external enforcement necessary once internal assent is secured
final_declaration: By the authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this verse establishes that Law originates in Svayambhu, manifests through sages, and executes through willing hearts. There is no punishment where there is alignment. Consciousness is the sole judge, and its verdict is always restoration.
